items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Yeah, and Bud Scott used to be our, with us.

ctx.x: Yes, he's in New York, I think he may be dead now I believe.
Yeah, and Bud Scott used to be our, with us.

Well I got him down here too. L.C. Tolan, now that's a piano player, oh yes, and Jimmy Clark, of course he wasn't of New Orleans, neither was James Alston, Gus Ivory, was from Birmingham, and Ferdinand Morton, which was a Jell-O. Did he work with your show too?
